scope: Agent Utils native TTS and standalone STT transports; not the full multimodal Realtime model's audio protocol

requirements.contract: Azure remains the compatibility default. Explicit azure/openai/daemon selection routes once, with no shell, local fallback or replay after indeterminate admission.

Daemon tokens resolve lazily per request from TTS/STT_DAEMON_TOKEN (DAMEON alias accepted), then a configurable symlink-compatible token file. Credentials never enter request bodies, diagnostics, session persistence or downstream audio child environments.

Daemon jobs correlate request IDs and receipts; remote playback owns central queue/output, local playback explicitly downloads bounded PCM from the exact receipt path. Only terminal receipts settle success; no global mute is issued on session cancellation.

Health is probed on every submission. Missing capabilities means legacy support: no unsupported pan/cancel/STT request_id is sent. A subsequent request discovers new deployment capabilities without a Pi restart.

Explicit abort cancels only owned TTS/STT jobs with an independent bounded cleanup signal. Cancelled/completed/failed/tombstoned/pending/unconfirmed outcomes are distinct; no global mute, automatic resubmission, or timeout-driven cancellation.

New daemon speech queues without aborting earlier requests by default; interrupt=true opts into replacement. Explicit off/stop/shutdown cancels owned pending requests; narration off leaves TTS intact. Pending client ownership is bounded.

Supported server playback receives explicit/session pan and verifies echoed pan, channels and rate. Explicit unsupported pan fails before admission; automatic session pan degrades with a warning. Raw playback omits pan, stays mono and is panned locally exactly once.
OpenAI audio/speech uses plain JSON PCM with provider-specific defaults and instruction controls; embeddings/unsupported controls fail explicitly. Body reads and cancellation remain bounded.

Read, assistant TTS, narration, choices, cascade and speak-replies share provider selection. STT/PTT, choice freeform and cascade input share batch provider selection; explicit realtime STT can use the daemon stream protocol.

Ctrl-Space is a Pi editor-scoped toggle: start local PTT, then finish/send exactly once. Raw Space/Ctrl-Space never start capture or toggle VAD. Kitty repeat/release, blocking prompts, disabled shortcuts, concurrent start/finish and shutdown are guarded; provider/model settings are unchanged.
Daemon STT streaming has bounded append queues, cursor deduplication, terminal/error handling and session abort/close cleanup; never replays audio after failure.

validation.focused: 36 daemon cancellation/panning/queue-policy contract tests passed against isolated HTTP servers, plus two released-PTT cancellation/shutdown regressions and the existing speech suites. Covers old/new capabilities, upgrade discovery, abort during lost admission, cancel_pending, cleanup timeout, token rotation, STT request IDs, generation cancellation and mono/local pan.

known_protocol_limits: Legacy daemons cannot cancel per job or pan. Failed/cancel_pending cleanup cannot establish silence. Timeouts do not cancel admitted jobs; their IDs are returned for explicit status/cancel recovery. Raw/local playback remains outside server playback control.
